pictureoftheday-not-scheduled: Shown when no dated entry, usable queue, or fallback page is available.
pictureoftheday-invalid-file: Shown when an entry has no valid file attribute.
pictureoftheday-invalid-start-date: Shown when the queue start attribute is not a valid YYYY-MM-DD date. $1 is the supplied value.
pictureoftheday-default-alt: Default alternative text for a picture when no alt attribute is supplied.
pictureoftheday-file-details: Label for a link to the file description and licensing page.
